title: Cursor
description: Learn how to use cursors for row-by-row processing of result sets.

data.text: A cursor is an object that enables traversal over the rows of a result set. It allows you to process individual rows returned by a query.

items: Declare the cursor with DECLARE cursor_name CURSOR FOR select_statement.
Open the cursor with OPEN cursor_name.
Fetch rows with FETCH NEXT FROM cursor INTO variable_list.
Close the cursor with CLOSE cursor_name.
Deallocate the cursor with DEALLOCATE cursor_name.

data.title: Declare, open, fetch, close, deallocate cursor
data.content: Processes product names and prices row by row.

data.title: Cursor Key Points
points: Cursors process result sets row by row.
Always close and deallocate cursors when done.
In practice, set-based operations are preferred over cursors.
Cursors can be slow for large result sets.
